capabilities: Create and edit shapes, text labels, frames, lines, arrows and Mermaid diagrams on an open board
Check layouts for overlapping shapes, overflowing text, crossing arrows and disconnected arrows
Export the board or selected elements as PNG or SVG for visual inspection or vault embeds
Align, distribute, restack, pan, zoom and search elements
Run a local MCP bridge with configurable port and optional bearer token
extras: Desktop only. The bridge binds strictly to 127.0.0.1 and exposes no arbitrary JavaScript evaluation; clear_scene needs explicit confirmation and vault saves accept only safe relative paths. Stdio clients need mcp-server.js from the GitHub Releases page.
problem: AI assistants cannot see or change what is on an Obsidian Excalidraw board, so diagrams have to be drawn, arranged and checked by hand.

relations.evidence: Let AI assistants create, edit, align, layout-check, and visually inspect your Excalidraw drawings right inside Obsidian
this plugin is detected automatically over local HTTP
Using with stdio MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Antigravity CLI, etc.)

summary: Local MCP bridge that lets AI assistants create, edit, layout-check and export Excalidraw drawings inside Obsidian.
